frame_id_scope: session_id plus actor lifecycle plus frame_id; immutable attachment uses create_new

result.client_update_counter: <local client update count; NOT server tick>

correlation.dispatch_sequence: <number of validated-envelope dispatches, including rejected actions>

identity_source: data.actor from native_renderer_ready; same session and lifecycle as native continuous-control actor
python_integration_requirements: Wait for native_renderer_ready and retain exact actor/session tokens.
Read image.path bytes, verify sha256 and dimensions, attach real image contents to provider; a path in a prompt is not image delivery.
Retain original PNG plus any compressed/cropped model input and transformation hashes.
Do not infer action-after effects from callback completion, file time, dispatch sequence or local client update counter.
Native errors and late receipts retain existing unknown-effect/no-blind-resubmit semantics.
No model inference or benchmark qualification is claimed by this schema.
status: bounded visual interaction successor; qualification recorded separately
timing_profile: voxygen-variable-dt-client-update-v1; not headless fixed-60Hz timing equivalence
transport: stdin/stdout NDJSON; diagnostics on stderr; local PNG attachments

ui_support.admin: no server_command or unfiltered chat through the rendered seam
ui_support.image: restricted image-receipts-v1 projection across all responses/events; no observe/events/health/hidden-target lookup
ui_support.structured_and_hybrid: retain original native protocol observation/step/continuous-control validators
ui_support.visible_item_slot_target_dialogue_trade_: native pointer inventory use/equip and dialogue; normal Talk prompt/statement continuation; trade unsupported

visual_ui.addressing: actual stock HUD pixels; no overlay or extracted choices
visual_ui.freshness: latest frame, same session/actor/UI contents/actuator; one gesture per frame
visual_ui.pending_unknown: collect original receipt only; duplicate action ID cannot execute again
visual_ui.receipts: existing native trackers; private exact canonical resolution, image-projected public receipt
